enrichment.headline: Approves a 3-year union contract with the administrators' union, with 5% raises and bonuses
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a tentative agreement with United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS), the union for the district's certificated and classified administrators, covering July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022. It includes a 5% ongoing raise starting July 1, 2020 for employees who are not retiring, a 5% raise effective January 1, 2020 for employees who retire on or before June 30, 2020, and bonuses. The text does not state a total dollar cost.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Collective Bargaining Agreement Between the District and United Administrators of Oakland Schools (UAOS)

enrichment.headline: Gives unrepresented, confidential and contract employees a 5% one-time payment and 5% ongoing raise
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution setting salary changes effective July 1, 2020 for employees who are not covered by a union contract, confidential employees, and employees with individual employment contracts. It provides a 5% one-time payment that is not added to the salary schedule and a 5% ongoing raise. The text does not state a total dollar cost.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Salary Adjustment - Unrepresented Employees, Confidential Employees and Employees With Contracts - Effective July 1, 2020

enrichment.headline: Approves a 3-year union contract with AFSCME Local 257 with 5% ongoing raises and bonuses
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a tentative agreement with the American Federation of State, County, and Municipal Employees (AFSCME), Local 257, covering July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2022. It includes a 5% ongoing salary increase effective July 1, 2020, bonuses and other provisions described in the agreement. The text does not state a total dollar cost.
